subject: Handoff playbook & staged activation matrix for Solstone
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@solstone.com>
To: marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@solstone.com
Date: 2027-05-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Handoff playbook & staged activation matrix for Solstone

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the call this morning. As discussed, Solstone is ready to move from POC into a staged activation. Attached is the initial checklist we use internally — it's a quick reference for the milestones we expect across Integration, Security, Workflow validation, and Go-live training.

Can you share Redwood's recommended MAP and a proposed timeline that maps owners to each milestone? Our target is a phased rollout starting the week of June 14, with the first internal pilot by June 28. Key constraints: SSO setup needs to be completed before the pilot and we need a security questionnaire answered by June 7.

I've included Carlos (engineering lead) and ops for transparency.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Rossi
Head of Product Operations
Solstone

Attachment: solstone-security-contacts.pdf (contact list, 1 page)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@solstone.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai, tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Handoff playbook & staged activation matrix for Solstone

Hi Elena — great to meet earlier. Appreciate the note and the internal checklist.

I've attached a first-pass MAP and staged activation matrix (solstone-map-v1.xlsx). High-level ask from our side: let CS own weekly checkpoints and acceptance gates; engineering will own SSO and network allowlist. Proposed highlights (details inside the workbook):
- Phase 0 (Prep): contract signed, seats provisioned, security Q answered — target by 2027-06-07
- Phase 1 (Pilot): integration + import test + pilot cohort training — 2027-06-14 to 2027-06-28
- Phase 2 (Wider rollout): performance tuning, cost profile review, production cutover window — 2027-07-05 to 2027-07-19

Can I ask Laura to coordinate the weekly runbook and acceptance criteria with your team? Ben will be our integration owner for API/webhook work, and Tessa will lead enablement during the pilot.

I'll schedule a 30-min kickoff for Tuesday, May 25, and invite the technical stakeholders. If that conflicts, reply here with times that work.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

Attachment: solstone-map-v1.xlsx (staged activation matrix, workbook)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: marcus.lin@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai, tessa.morgan@redwood.ai, elena.rossi@solstone.com
Date: 2027-05-18T14:26:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Handoff playbook & staged activation matrix for Solstone

On Tue, May 18, 2027 at 11:03 AM Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Elena — great to meet earlier. Appreciate the note and the internal checklist.
> 
> I've attached a first-pass MAP and staged activation matrix (solstone-map-v1.xlsx). High-level ask from our side: let CS own weekly checkpoints and acceptance gates; engineering will own SSO and network allowlist. Proposed highlights (details inside the workbook):
> - Phase 0 (Prep): contract signed, seats provisioned, security Q answered — target by 2027-06-07
> - Phase 1 (Pilot): integration + import test + pilot cohort training — 2027-06-14 to 2027-06-28
> - Phase 2 (Wider rollout): performance tuning, cost profile review, production cutover window — 2027-07-05 to 2027-07-19

Thanks Marcus — looping in the CS delivery crew and Solstone's contacts so we have a single source of truth. A few concrete items from our side after reviewing Marcus's matrix:

Action items and owners (first pass)
- CS kickoff & cadence: Laura Bennett (owner) — schedule weekly 30-min checkpoints starting 2027-05-26 (recurring)
- Integration/API work: Ben Carter (owner) — complete API key exchange and webhook validation by 2027-06-10
- SSO & network allowlist: Solstone eng (Carlos Vega) + Redwood infra (Ben) — SSO test accounts by 2027-06-07
- Security questionnaire & evidence: Laura (owner) — provide answers and Redwood evidence links by 2027-06-07
- Pilot training & materials: Tessa Morgan (owner) — train pilot cohort week of 2027-06-14
- Acceptance criteria: joint sign-off doc to be created by 2027-06-03 (template attached in workbook)

Risks to flag
- If SSO is delayed > 2027-06-07, pilot shifts by at least one sprint (2 weeks)
- Large data import volumes will require a performance run on Dedicated pool ahead of pilot — Ben will coordinate with infra if needed

Next steps
1) Marcus to send calendar invites for the kickoff and weekly checkpoints (done).
2) Solstone to confirm SSO contacts and provide a test user list.
3) Laura to post the MAP workbook to the shared Drive and create the acceptance criteria doc.

Elena, Carlos — let us know if these owners look correct and if you can commit to the dates above. If anything needs to move, we can rework the matrix but want to lock acceptance gates early.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: (referenced workbook posted to Drive)

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@solstone.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, tessa.morgan@redwood.ai, c.vega@solstone.com
Date: 2027-05-19T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Handoff playbook & staged activation matrix for Solstone

Thanks Laura — that looks great and aligned with our expectations. Quick notes from ops/engineering:
- We can commit to SSO test accounts by 2027-06-04 (a few days earlier than requested) and will upload a test user CSV to the Drive folder by EOD 2027-05-20.
- Security questionnaire: we'll upload our responses and an inbound firewall diagram; Laura, if you can link the SOC2 scope and log-retention evidence, that will help speed legal review.

One ask: can Redwood include a short runbook for failover behavior during the pilot (steps and contacts) — Ben, can you draft the tech runbook and post it to the Drive?

Appreciate the quick coordination. Looking forward to the kickoff next week.

Best,
Elena

Attachment: solstone-security-contacts.pdf (re-sent)
